abilities.name: Peregrination of Linnunrata
_curatorNotes: ⚓ BOTH CHARGED FORMS ARE MODELLED (charged-forms round, 2026-09-16 — docs/rounds/lauma-charged-forms-round.md). This ability's `C` is SPIRIT ENVOY METAMORPHOSIS, the deer: gcsim charge.go `deerFrames` = InitAbilSlice(64) with ActionAttack 61, ActionCharge/Skill/Burst 63, ActionSwap/Jump 49 (the transformation frame); no D key because dash.go refuses the dash in deer form (D falls to `anim`). It lands NO HIT — `nonHitting.charged` — and opens `spiritEnvoy` for 10s (deerDur 600f; C1's +5s is not modelled), ended by her next attack or cast (`terminatesOnAction`; gcsim chargeInit's OnActionExec hook ends it on anything but walk/jump) or a swap (`terminatesOnSwap`; the OnCharacterSwap hook). ⚓ Nate: neither a dash nor a jump ends it — she moves in deer form. When it ends, `onEnd` opens `envoyCooldown` for 4s (endDeerState: `4 * 60 * a4SpiritEnvoyCooldownReduction()`), and while THAT runs `C` resolves to the Spiritcall Prayer sibling ability below. gcsim's `deerStateReady` starts true (lauma.go), so the first `C` of any rotation is the deer, as here.

Not modelled, deliberately: the A4 cooldown reduction (−0.02%/EM, floor ×0.8 at 1000 EM — our modifiers carry no EM term; ⚓ Nate: a caveat, not a simulation); C1's +5s deer duration and −40% Stamina; the burst's `burstDeerFrame` (Q→C cancels at 115 when the deer is ready, 110 otherwise — a cancel key cannot depend on which `C` follows; 5f). The Prayer's own `Frames(next)` returns chargeReleaseFrame (67) for a following deer, identical to its table, so nothing is lost there.

The frames audit: the dumper's bare `C` capture IS the deer (deerStateReady starts true), so this map now agrees with the oracle where the T0 pass had to defend a Prayer map against it — measured 2026-09-16, no row for it. The Prayer sibling is reached through drivers.json `states.envoyCooldown` = charge (deer), burst (ends it; ⚠️ an `attack` ender rotates gcsim's normal counter and produced three false N1–N3 rows) — then the captured `C` is Prayer.
No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.

abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

abilities.caveat: Spiritcall Prayer is available for 4s after Spirit Envoy form ends here; with high Elemental Mastery that window is up to 0.8s shorter in game, so a late Charged Attack may enter Spirit Envoy form instead.

abilities.name: Spiritcall Prayer
abilities.description:
Spiritcall Prayer
While Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is on cooldown, Lauma's Charged Attack consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.
_curatorNotes: The ATTACK half of Lauma's Charged Attack (charged-forms round, 2026-09-16): a state-gated sibling normal ability on `envoyCooldown` — the Zibai/Durin shape — that `resolveActiveAbility` prefers over Peregrination of Linnunrata while the cooldown runs. The N1–N3 hits are copied from the base because a sibling REPLACES it for every action class while its gate holds (Durin's dark form is the precedent), so her normal string must travel with it.

chargeFrames = gcsim charge.go `chargeFrames` = InitAbilSlice(68) with ActionAttack/Skill/Burst/Dash/Jump/Swap at chargeReleaseFrame 67; the Dendro 25 / ICDTagNone hit at chargeHitmark 73 lands AFTER the release, hence `hit` > the cancel keys. ⚠️ THE FRAMES AUDIT REPORTS `hit 73→67` AND 73 IS RIGHT: `toFrameMap` infers a normal-style map's `hit` as the value every cancel key shares (67, the release tier), which is the hitmark tier for a swing built by InitNormalCancelSlice but not for a slice built by InitAbilSlice + explicit keys; gcsim's QueueAttack is at chargeHitmark 73. Inert at runtime either way — every cancel key is explicit, so `frameAt` never falls to `hit` — ⛔ don't migrate it. ICDTagNone is what the catalyst rule in resolveActionIcd already gives a charged attack, so no `chargedIcdWindow`. Scaling: charge[TalentLvlAttack] (zz_lauma.dm.go), not authored — a charged attack's damage is not a data field here.

⚠️ Gated on `envoyCooldown` ALONE, not on `any(spiritEnvoy, envoyCooldown)`: `settleOwnerStates` closes the deer BEFORE the snapshot a `C` resolves against, so a `C` during the deer already reads the cooldown (gcsim: `deerStateReady` is false while the deer stands, so that `C` is Prayer there too) — and a single-state gate is what keeps the frames audit able to reach this map (gcsim-map's prereqFor resolves one `state` condition through drivers.json).

abilities.name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Hold variant requires ≥1 Verdant Dew (c.Core.Player.VerdantDew()); gcsim returns an error if VerdantDew=0. Verdant Dew is a team-level resource not yet modeled in the schema. D omitted — ActionDash not explicitly set in skillFrames[1]; stays at InitAbilSlice default 64 (AnimationLength).

application authored 2026-09-15: gcsim skillHold queues 'Hymn of Eternal Rest (Hold)' — Dendro, Durability 25, ICDTagNone — at skillHoldHitmark 45; the Lunar-Bloom half (queued after the Dew consume at 29f) carries no Durability and applies nothing. With no list the variant inherited the Tap's frame-16 entry and applied 29 frames early. The oracle cannot check it: the dumper's driver fails with 'Cannot use Skill Hold without Dew'.

gcsim internal/characters/lauma/skill.go: Skill() queues frostgroveSantuaryTick ×skillTicks(8) at skillFirstTickDelay(62) + frostgroveSanctuaryInterval(117)·i — interval 117/60 = 1.95s, firstTickDelay (62 − spawnsAt 0)/60 = 1.033s. Tick AttackInfo: Element Dendro, Durability 25 (1U), ICDTag ICDTagNone → icdGate 'none' (gcsim-frames-diff §5 measured 8/8 none, 62f/117f ×8, matching exactly).

scaling = frostgroveSanctuaryAtk[9] = 1.728 (zz_lauma.dm.go) = 172.8% ATK at talent level 10; sidecar row 'Frostgrove Sanctuary Attack DMG' 10th value = '172.8% ATK+345.6% Elemental Mastery'. The EM addend (FlatDmg = EM × frostgroveSanctuaryEM[9] = 3.456) is not expressible in the single-stat damage effect and is omitted — schema gap, ATK term only.

C6 (c6OnFrostgroveTick, cons.go) adds a paired Lunar-Bloom hit per tick, but its AttackInfo has Durability 0 — it applies nothing and does not change this series' cadence or count, so no constellation-gated variant is authored.

Frostgrove Sanctuary: 8 ticks starting at frame 62, then every 117 frames (skillFirstTickDelay=62, frostgroveSanctuaryInterval=117). gcsim ticks use NewCircleHitOnTarget(player, nil, 6) — centered on player position, which may indicate it follows the caster. Game description implies a placed field; reviewer to verify mobility in-game.

Dendro + Hydro RES shred authored 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): gcsim skill.go:226-241 applySkillShredCB adds both ResistMods for 10*60f, wired into the skill hits and Frostgrove Sanctuary ticks (skill.go:96,149,168); lauma_gen.go skillResShred[9] = 0.25 (TL10). Authored as onHit skill with durationType refresh (Escoffier inspirationimmersed_seasoning dual-element precedent); Sanctuary ticks also reapply the shred in game, so uptime is effectively continuous while the sanctuary lives — the skill-hit trigger is the corpus approximation.

Moon Song: Hold variant grants 1 Moon Song stack per Verdant Dew consumed (max 3 per cast). If Moon Song is active when Burst is used (or Burst is active when Moon Song is gained), each stack ×6 = additional Pale Hymn, once per burst use. Unspent Moon Song expires after 15s. Effect not authored — needs reviewer pass.
abilities.description:
Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a **Frostgrove Sanctuary** with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.

Hold
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 **Verdant Dew**. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of **Moon Song**. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.

Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's Dendro RES and Hydro RES will be decreased for 10s.

abilities.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
_curatorNotes: Pale Hymn: 18-stack EM-scaling buff (gained at paleHymnGainFrame=96 after cast). Individual stack durations 15s each. Stacks consumed when nearby party members deal Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon/LunarBloom DMG (1 stack per enemy hit). FlatDmg per consumed stack: bloomDmgIncrease[L]×EM for Bloom-type reactions, lunarBloomDmgIncrease[L]×EM for LunarBloom. No entity spawned; Pale Hymn is a buff-stack on Lauma. burstKey status (15s) tracks the Moon Song interaction window. Reviewer to decide effect representation.

J omitted from frames — ActionJump not explicitly set in burstFrames init; stays at InitAbilSlice default 115 (AnimationLength). No initial burst damage queued in gcsim burst.go — burst only sets Pale Hymn stacks.

activeDuration 15 (2026-09-15, essential-characters T0): the Pale Hymn window — gcsim burst.go AddStatus(paleHymnBurstKey, paleHymnDur = 15*60) at the 18-stack grant — so the burst draws the span its whole payload lives in instead of an instant pill. The per-stack reaction DMG is EM-scaled magnitude and stays out; stacks consumed early are not tracked, so the span is the stacks' longest life.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/rounds/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim lauma/burst.go: one task at f96 granting Pale Hymn, no attack.
abilities.description:
Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of **Pale Hymn**.
Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has **Moon Song**, or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use.

Pale Hymn
When nearby party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.

constellations.name: "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North"
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. C2 augments Pale Hymn via c2PaleHymnScalingBloom() (adds EM×5 FlatDmg to Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon hits) and c2PaleHymnScalingLunarBloom() (adds EM×4 FlatDmg to LunarBloom hits), applied inside the initBurst() OnEnemyHit listener alongside Pale Hymn consumption. Probable trigger: onHit with AttackTag condition {Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, LunarBloom}, active during burstKey window. Effect skeleton has one entry (500% Bloom path) but the 400% LunarBloom path is missing — needs a second effect entry.

Moonsign Ascendant Gleam +40% Lunar-Bloom DMG authored 2026-05-09 against the new lunarBloomDmgBonus stat + teamFaction runtime resolution (B work). Trigger keyed on Q cast with constellation:2 + teamFaction:moonsign,min:2 conditions. Duration set to 15s (Pale Hymn / burst window default); gcsim c2Init applies the AddReactBonusMod for the burst's active window. Re-check duration if a cleaner 'burst-active' state primitive lands.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North" — effects[0] (damage scaling 500 em) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/lauma/burst.go:85` — inside `initBurst()`'s `OnEnemyHit` listener, while Pale Hymn stacks are live, `ae.Info.FlatDmg += em * c.c2PaleHymnScalingBloom()` (= EM × 5) is added to Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon/BountifulCore hits, and `burst.go:88` adds EM × 4 to `AttackTagDirectLunarBloom` hits (`cons.go:104-119`). Retained: (a) that this is a per-REACTION-instance flat-DMG add-on (`FlatDmg`, gcsim's bucket), **not** an `elevate` and **not** a `*ReactionBonus` — conflating it with either would put it in the wrong damage bracket; and (b) that the `Stat` member it needs does not exist. The union has only `lunarCrystallizeFlatDmg` in that family, whose own doc says "the other lunar / classical-reaction flavors will be added on demand" — this kit is the demand (`bloomFlatDmg` / `hyperbloomFlatDmg` / `burgeonFlatDmg` / `lunarBloomFlatDmg`), and minting four Stat members is a round, not a retirement. ⚠️ ⛔ **Do not act on the existing note's instruction to "add a second effect entry" for the 400% Lunar-Bloom path** — that would author a second dead effect. ⚠️ Note also that the BASE Pale Hymn bonus (`burst.go:84`/`:87`, `bloomDmgIncrease`/`lunarBloomDmgIncrease` off the burst's own talent table) is equally unauthored — Lauma's burst has `effects: []` — so C2's increment has no sibling to attach to and would read as a bonus on a bonus that is not drawn. C2's other effect (the +40% `lunarBloomDmgBonus` Moonsign buff, `effects[1]`) is unaffected and stays.

constellations.name: "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight"
_curatorNotes: First effect (185% EM, LunarBloom): Frostgrove Sanctuary ticks trigger an additional LunarBloom hit at 185% EM (c6OnFrostgroveTick, c6SkillHitName='Frostgrove Sanctuary C6'). Up to 8× per sanctuary (c6Count cap), resets on skill recast. Provides Lauma 2 Pale Hymn stacks (addC6PaleHymnCB) per trigger. Periodic trigger tied to sanctuary ticks — not a standard onCast/onHit pattern; reviewer to decide trigger representation.

Second effect (150% EM, LunarBloom): when Lauma performs Normal Attack with Pale Hymn stacks > 0, consumes 1 stack and the normal attack becomes LunarBloom DMG ×150% EM (attack.go C6 branch at top of Attack()). Probable trigger: onCast with ability normalAttack + condition Pale Hymn > 0; target self. Not a buff applied to external hits — Lauma's own N is converted.

Third effect: Moonsign Ascendant Gleam +25% Lunar-Bloom Elevation team-wide (c6ElevationBonus=0.25, gcsim subscribes OnEnemyHit, filters AttackTagDirectLunarBloom). Authored 2026-05-10 as an `elevate` effect (target=team, reactions=lunarBloom, gated on Cons:6 + Moonsign:2).

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight" — effects[0] (damage scaling 185 em, dendro) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/lauma/cons.go:176-208` — `c6OnFrostgroveTick()` queues an extra `AttackInfo{ Abil: "Frostgrove Sanctuary C6", AttackTag: AttackTagDirectLunarBloom, Element: Dendro, Mult: 1.85, UseEM: true, **Durability: 0** }` (`cons.go:193`) on each Sanctuary tick, capped at 8 per Sanctuary (`c6Count`), reset by a skill recast (`c6OnSkill`). Retained: the 8-per-Sanctuary cap, the reset on skill recast, and the 2 Pale Hymn stacks it grants (`addC6PaleHymnCB`) — the mechanically live half, which is unreachable while Pale Hymn itself is unmodelled. ⚓ The verdict is already corroborated in-repo: the Frostgrove Sanctuary summon tick's own curator note states "its AttackInfo has Durability 0 — it applies nothing and does not change this series' cadence or count, so no constellation-gated variant is authored." ⚠️ A re-trigger *is* expressible — `{"type":"onHit","abilityType":"skill","filter":{"abilityName":"Frostgrove Sanctuary"}}`, the exact shape Lauma's C4 already uses to ride the same ticks (a summon tick's hit record carries the summon's label as `abilityName`, `finalize.ts:645`) — but it would draw **nothing**: a `damage` effect reaches a surface only through a measured `application[]`, and Durability 0 means the honest array is `[]`. ⛔ Never author a non-empty `application[]` here to buy a pip; it would put a Dendro tick in the aura lane that the game does not apply.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight" — effects[1] (damage scaling 150 em, dendro) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/lauma/attack.go:51-61` — at C6 with `paleHymnCount() > 0` her Normal Attack's own `AttackInfo` is **rewritten in place** (`Abil: "Normal C6 Pale Hymn"`, `AttackTag: AttackTagDirectLunarBloom`, `Mult: 1.5`, `UseEM: true`, `ICDTag: ICDTagNone`, **`Durability: 0`**) and one stack is consumed. It is a conversion, not an added instance. Retained: that this is a CONVERSION of her own normal (`attack.go:51`), so the interesting consequence is that her swings stop applying Dendro (Durability 25 → 0), and that it is gated on Pale Hymn stacks, which are unmodelled. Drop the note's "Probable trigger: onCast with ability normalAttack" — `onCast` takes only `'skill' | 'burst'`. ⚠️ ⛔ Do not author this as a `damage` effect on an `onHit abilityType:'normal'` trigger — it would claim an *extra* hit where the game *replaces* one, and a `damage` effect draws nothing anyway. The honest shape is a state-gated sibling normal ability (the Lauma deer / Spiritcall Prayer pattern) plus a Pale Hymn stack resource; that is a character round, not this one.
constellations.description:
When the **Frostgrove Sanctuary** attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any **Pale Hymn** stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill **Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko**, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed.

Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal Dendro DMG equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is **elevated** by 25%.
